research_question: Which approximations damage classification under point-count and shape variation, and can statistical representation, precision and shared primitives improve the quality-cost tradeoff?
review: Recover original research objective; frozen QAT is a baseline, RF is supporting evidence, neither is the final algorithm objective. Single-executor pre-run review.

data.fusion: Original K7, GT tracks, no temporal changes

representations.legacy: Existing Feature21 INT8 plus already-trained frozen-QAT seeds 7/17
representations.proxy_scaled: Existing pre-output-quantization proxy statistics with train-only power-of-two per-feature INT8 scaling; density retains original quantized value
representations.moment24: First-point shifted sums and x/y second moments with shared reciprocal LUT Q24; x/y variances, covariance and max/min diagonal variances replace proxy shape slots; other definitions retained
representations.moment16: Same moment representation, reciprocal Q16; identical output scales fitted from moment24 train
representations.uncentered16: Numerical diagnostic only: same Q16 formula without origin shift, evaluated with moment24 weights; no separately fitted model

precision.output: Symmetric INT8 with per-feature power-of-two steps calibrated at train absolute 99.99 percentile; density step=1
precision.arithmetic: Integer sums, ties-to-even, nonnegative diagonal variance clamp; report negative preclamp cases; signed 64-bit reference with proven bounds
precision.dimension: 21 held fixed to isolate representation/precision; not a claim that 21 is optimal

training.protocol: Reuse full-train frozen-QAT baseline protocol: 20 FP32 epochs, fold normalization, fixed scales, QAT 20..60 epochs, train-only plateau; no validation checkpoint selection

diagnostics.interpretation: Offline point deletion/coordinate quantization sensitivity, not calibrated physical radar corruptions or new independent real data
diagnostics.supported_group: At least 100 rows, 3 sequences, and both classes for macro-F1

rf.purpose: Classifier-family crosscheck and grouped input dependence, no RF-directed feature elimination

decision.candidate_quality: Compare moments to both legacy and proxy_scaled matched baselines; report all seeds, supported conditional groups and paired damage/repair
decision.precision_rule: Exploratory acceptance of Q16 only if both seeds satisfy tolerances vs Q24 on clean and every predefined perturbation; not a business requirement
decision.stop: Stop at six trajectories and report positive/negative findings; no automatic parameter or feature search, no RTL promotion solely from proxy cost
